candidate.definition_en: Decided on beforehand (such as a time or place); equipped or furnished; or chosen for a position.
candidate.explanation_ar: تأتي بمعنى مُحَدَّد مسبقًا (مثل: appointed time)، أو مُجَهَّز ومفروش (مثل: well-appointed room)، أو مُعَيَّن في وظيفة أو منصب.

senses.definition_en: Decided on or arranged in advance (such as a time or place).
senses.definition_ar: مُحَدَّد أو مُتَّفَق عليه مسبقًا (مثل موعد أو مكان).
examples: He arrived at the appointed time.

senses.definition_en: Chosen or officially designated for a job or responsibility.
examples: She is the newly appointed manager.

senses.definition_en: Equipped or furnished in a specified manner.
examples: We stayed in a luxuriously appointed suite at the hotel.
He arrived at the appointed time.
She is the newly appointed manager.
We stayed in a luxuriously appointed suite at the hotel.
candidate.mnemonic: من 'Appointment' يعني موعد.. لما حاجة تكون 'Appointed' يعني تم تحديدها أو تعيينها.
